skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the transformation of business through information systems and their components.
Analyze business processes and their relationship with information systems.
Examine the impact of information systems on organizations and competitive strategies.
Comprehend the stages and drivers of IT infrastructure evolution and current trends.
Identify the capabilities of database management systems and their impact on business performance.
Understand the components of telecommunications networks and key networking technologies.
Recognize the vulnerabilities of information systems and tools for safeguarding them.
Expand vocabulary specific to the field of Management Information Systems.
Demonstrate ability to read and understand specialized texts in the field of Management Information Systems.
Show proficiency in listening and understanding detailed information in the context of Management Information Systems.
Express knowledge and engage in discussions on topics related to Management Information Systems.
Write reports and presentations on topics related to Management Information Systems.
Deliver presentations on topics related to Management Information Systems.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems related to Management Information Systems.
